summary: Iteration 40 — Frontend-only OFFLINE SIMULATION of 'BIBLIA – Permanent Offline Edition'. Every Playwright run blocked all '/api/' requests and every non-preview-host request. The app made ZERO /api calls and ZERO external calls in all 7 runs. The only blocked URL was static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon, which the preview infrastructure injects; it is not app code. A grep found no http(s) asset URLs (unsplash/CDN) anywhere in src/ or app/. Also: no page errors and no red screens. PASSED: (1) Bible tab: 1Mo 1, Ps 23, Jes 53, Offb 22, Obd 1, 3Joh 1, Joh 3 and Röm 8 all render their ELB 1905 text. The book code for Obadja is 'Obd'. An unknown code such as 'Ob' silently falls back to Johannes. (2) Full-text search: 'Hirte' gives 60 hits (truncated), starting at 1Mo 13,7. 'Moses' gives 60 hits, starting at 2Mo 8,13. 'Gnade Frieden' gives 2 hits (Jer 16,5 and Röm 16,20), so the multi-word AND search works. Tapping a result opens the right book and chapter. (3) Verse study: Joh 3,16 shows Calvin (calvin-43-3-16) and MHCC (mhcc-43-3-9). Röm 8,28 shows Calvin. Both have source filters. Cross references load (xref-t0/xref-a*, 13–14 entries), and tapping one shows the preview text. /study/sources lists 7 sources. In /study/collection, the Bible search for 'Hirte' gives 50 hits. (4) Library: the cover is a local asset (naturalWidth 1000). The 'Hören & Sehen' shelf (open-media) opens /media. (5) /media: the media-bundled-empty hint shows. media-import-button opens the file chooser (multiple). An MP3 and an MP4 were imported and both show as media-item-*, with a 'Datei(en) hinzugefügt' toast. The audio player plays: the label changes Abspielen→Pause, the time goes 0:00→0:03 and Pause works. The video player shows a native <video> with controls. Remove works for both items, and the now-playing card closes when its item is removed. (6) Settings: full-backup-button downloads biblia-vollsicherung-YYYY-MM-DD.json with kind 'biblia-vollsicherung' and the keys app/kind/version/exportedAt/state/way/keys/photos. The file contains the TEST_ note and the TEST_ diary entry. Round trip: created the note and the diary entry, exported, reset the Lernstand and deleted the diary entry (0 notes, 0 entries), restored. Toast: 'Wiederhergestellt: Lernstand, 1 Tagebucheinträge, 0 Fotos'. Afterwards the library shows '1 Notiz' and the diary has 1 entry, still there after a reload. An invalid file ({"foo":1}) gives the toast 'keine BIBLIA-Vollsicherung'. A non-JSON file gives 'konnte nicht gelesen werden'. The existing JSON export/import still works ('Lernstand importiert'). Feeding a full backup into the simple import is rejected with 'Die Datei ist kein BIBLIA-Lernstand'. (7) Offline regression: the intro daily verse renders (5. Mose 31,6 · ELB 1905). The home atlas renders (atlas-relief, cluster badges, no broken images). World gospels has 10 station nodes, and station john-1 renders. The lexicon search finds 'Abraham' and the article renders. The timeline shows 138 entries. The Mein geistlicher Weg register has 24 topic cards and a topic page opens. (8) Responsive layout at 360x640 and 390x844: no horizontal overflow on /media or the settings backup section. All buttons are 312–342 x 52, and the back button is 44x44. No deprecated Expo packages were found (expo-audio and expo-video are used, not expo-av). expo-updates is not installed, and app.json has updates.enabled=false.

ui_bugs.issue: Bad plural: 'Wiederhergestellt: Lernstand, 1 Tagebucheinträge, …'. It should read '1 Tagebucheintrag' (and '1 Foto'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx:61

On web, a very long file name with underscores and no spaces runs right up to (or touches) the trash icon at 360px width. Add a break strategy or ellipsis, or give rowTitle some paddingRight. Reference: /app/frontend/app/media.tsx:69

issues: The restore replaces the diary ('replace') and overwrites the Lernstand with no confirmation sheet. Any data created after the backup is lost silently. Suggest a confirm sheet like the one for reset.

action_items: LOW: Fix the singular/plural wording in the restore toast (settings.tsx:61).
LOW: Add a confirm step before 'Vollsicherung wiederherstellen' overwrites the current data and the diary.

LOW: When restoring on another device, biblia_media_v1 is restored with the old device's file:// URIs, but the MP3/MP4 files themselves are not in the backup. The result is media entries that do not play. Drop entries whose file does not exist after restore, or mark them as missing.

LOW: importMedia uses copyToCacheDirectory:true and then copies the file again into documents/media. The cache copy is never deleted, so large MP4 files take twice the space until the OS clears the cache. Delete the cache file after copying.
LOW: The media row title needs to handle long unbroken file names (media.tsx:69).

INFO: exportFullBackup builds one JSON string with every photo as base64 in memory. Many or large photos could hit memory limits on low-end Android devices. Consider a warning about size or a streaming/zip approach later.
critical_code_review_comments: fullBackup.ts: photos are keyed only by file name (fileName(uri)). Two photos with the same name in different folders would overwrite each other. This is unlikely with picker-generated names.

fullBackup.ts: keys restored through AsyncStorage.multiSet do not refresh in-memory stores that are already loaded (for example the media store's loaded flag). The toast correctly asks the user to restart the app.
media.ts: on web the media list is never loaded from storage but is still written to it. This is harmless and documented in the UI hint.
bible.tsx: an unknown ?b= code silently falls back to Johannes. Acceptable, but worth knowing for deep links.
No http(s) asset or API URLs in src/ or app/. utils/upload.ts and the backend are no longer referenced by the app's runtime paths.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/media.tsx (wrapped VideoView in a View with testID='media-video-player', because VideoView on web does not forward testID to the DOM)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (2 low cosmetic issues)

seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ note on Joh 3,16 and a TEST_Dankbar diary check-in in browser localStorage only (separate Playwright contexts). Media TEST_ items were removed. No server data was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Close the intro with 'Überspringen' and then 'Bibel entdecken'. intro-daily-verse only exists during the intro animation, before you skip it. The book code for Obadja is 'Obd'. Deep link format: /bible?b=<code>&ch=<n>&v=<n>. Search: bible-options-toggle → bible-search-button → bible-search-input → bible-search-submit → search-result-<i>. The options panel may stay open after a result tap, so check that bible-search-button is visible before toggling. Verse sheet tabs: verse-tab-me / verse-tab-comm / verse-tab-xref. Media import and full restore both open a browser file chooser: use page.expect_file_chooser with buffer payloads. Full backup uses page.expect_download. Helper snippet: /app/test_reports/iter40_offline_helpers.py. Ignore the static.cloudflareinsights.com beacon; the preview infrastructure injects it.
